nurse.text: Welcome to the Cork Sanctuary. Fáilte, and sit down. Pop your team on the counter. And no, we're not Dublin.
What can we do for you?

then.text: Right so. Have a look at the state of them. I'll have them fixed in the time it takes to say 'Rebel County'.
All set. Go and see the market, and mind the Shandon bells, they're loud at noon.
The Ark terminal. It's the only thing in Cork that's quiet. Take advantage of it.

else.text: No bother. The kettle's on, and the door's open.

cork_bureau.text: Bureau de change counter. Sanctuary rates, which is to say, the same as everyone else's.
